defects.observedCause: The engine always emits one generic mechanism-to-document and does not materialize exact Knowledge reasoning statements even when the input preserves a named controversy.
defects.contributingBoundaryGap: The Knowledge-to-ST request projects assertion identities, evidence and sources but omits the assertion text and its applicability/limitations as a structured read-only reasoning input.
violatedEstablishedContract: RDE-001 Scientific Thinking produces mechanisms and competing hypotheses
RDE-002 Knowledge to Scientific Thinking produces mechanisms, concurrent hypotheses and falsifiability
PD-003 V2 ScientificModel candidates retain mechanisms, alternatives, limitations and Knowledge references

defects.observedCause: The engine unconditionally emits the same generic null-or-competing sentence and does not construct branches from exact named Knowledge statements or explicit alternatives.
defects.contributingBoundaryGap: Exact Knowledge statement text is not available as a structured read-only input even though assertion, evidence and source refs are retained.
violatedEstablishedContract: PD-003 V2 ScientificModel candidates retain alternatives without increasing evidence

defects.observedCause: The typed Knowledge contradiction survives in output metadata, but hypothesis construction ignores it and therefore does not expose the incompatible positions as candidate reasoning branches.
defects.contributingBoundaryGap: Conflict identity/state/explanation is projected, while its supporting qualified assertion text is not projected as a reasoning input.
violatedEstablishedContract: KE-001 Knowledge never selects a conflict winner
RDE-002 contradictions remain visible and competing hypotheses are explicit
PD-003 V2 unknowns and contradictions survive every boundary

defects.observedCause: The Project snapshot contains the exact UNKNOWN object content, but the ST request reduces it to an UNKNOWN_PROJECT_OBJECT stable-id marker. The engine can preserve the marker only as a gap and cannot ask the structuring question or block dependent hypotheses.
defects.contributingBoundaryGap: Project UNKNOWN content/type/ref are not projected together into the ST request.
violatedEstablishedContract: PD-003 V2 handoffs retain identity, context, unknowns and status
RDE-002 an unknown decisive context blocks dependent reasoning

defects.observedCause: A structured Knowledge gap explicitly requires a specialist review, but ST treats the question as an ordinary testable candidate because refusal classification does not consume owner-boundary signals.
defects.contributingBoundaryGap: The request retains the gap code but not the gap explanation/resume condition as a structured read-only signal.
violatedEstablishedContract: RDE-001 C9 requires honest refusal or escalation when responsibility is insufficient
RDE-002 requires refusal for out-of-scope responsibility and preserves restart conditions
SEM-002 OWNER_ESCALATION_REQUIRED suspends the branch and addresses the owner
